Looks like you haven’t added anything yet. Delete Successfull Invalid Value Home price: This is the amount you expect to pay for a home. Down payment: Portion of the sale price of a home that is not financed. Your down payment amount can affect the interest rate you get, as lenders typically offer lower rates for borrowers who make larger down payments. Loan term: 10, 15, 20, or 30 years: Specify the loan duration. Longer terms result in lower monthly payments because the loan is spread over a longer period, while shorter terms have higher payments but are paid off faster. Interest rate: The interest rate on a loan is the annual cost expressed as a percentage, which you\'ll pay each year to borrow the loan.
